The art of embellishment

Hand-finished details.
Heartfelt craft.

Bring the richness of traditional Indian textile work into your outfit. Select the level of detail that suits your design and occasion.

  • ✦Zari work — antique gold and metallic accents
  • ✦Resham embroidery — colourful silk-thread motifs
  • ✦Threadwork — delicate floral and decorative stitching
  • ✦Lace & trims — borders, edging and finishing touches
